summary: Closed the open discriminator from the first pass. Sources show a confirmed read context cannot lose its ReadIndexResp/ReadyToRead to a same-batch step-down: confirm and emission run in one handler frame, and reset() leaves r.msgs and r.readyToRead intact, with Peer.Commit clearing them only after the Update reaches the node layer. Answered the registered gap as resolved, marked the investigation explained with no defect claim, and added the Update-lifetime behavior entry; the residual follower-side stale leader id after a post-step-down ReadIndexResp is recorded as an unquantified liveness limitation. No execution was run this turn.
